upregulated Egr1/2 and Osr1, increased Islet1+ mesenchyme cells, downregulated Shox2 in thoracic LPMs

model_organism.citation: Generation and characterization of a knockout mouse of an enhancer of EBF3 (PMID: 41081394)
model_organism.knockout_type: other (enhancer deletion, Rr169617 het and homozygous; partial reduction of Ebf3 expression)
phenotypes: Ebf3 expression reduced by about 10% in heterozygotes and 20% in homozygotes
dysregulated histone and brain development genes in E12.5 brain
sex-specific reduced mobility in homozygous males versus females across open field, hole board and light/dark tests
body composition differences in both sexes when homozygous
model_organism.significance: deviation from Mendelian expectation P=0.02; depletion of deletion allele P=5.8×10-4

biological.citation: Seike et al. 2018 - Stem cell niche-specific Ebf3 maintains the bone marrow cavity (PMID: 29563184)
biological.summary: Lineage tracing showed Ebf3 is preferentially expressed in CAR/LepR+ mesenchymal stem cells of adult bone marrow. Deleting Ebf3 (and Ebf1/Ebf3) in these cells impaired HSC niche function and caused osteosclerosis, so Ebf3 inhibits osteoblast differentiation and keeps the marrow cavity open.

biological.citation: Loss of Notch signaling in skeletal stem cells enhances bone formation with aging (PMID: 37752132)
biological.summary: Ebf3 was identified as a downstream mediator of Notch signaling in skeletal stem and progenitor cells and is dysregulated with aging. Nicastrin deletion in these cells increased bone mass in aged mice.

biological.citation: Transient and lineage-restricted requirement of Ebf3 for sternum ossification (PMID: 32398354)
biological.summary: Ebf3 marks tenocytes and connective tissue cells in zebrafish. Mouse Ebf3 knockout caused sternum ossification defects through loss of Runx2+ pre-osteoblasts, with a requirement at E9.5-10.5 in lateral plate mesenchyme. Loss of Ebf3 raised Egr1/2 and Osr1 and lowered Shox2.

biological.citation: Wang et al. 2014 - Ebf factors and MyoD cooperate to regulate muscle relaxation via Atp2a1 (PMID: 24786561)
biological.summary: Ebf3 binds the Atp2a1 (Serca1) promoter directly and synergizes with MyoD to induce it. Ebf3-null mice have a hypercontractile diaphragm and die perinatally of respiratory failure, and transgenic Serca1 rescues this.

biological.citation: Harms et al. 2017 - Mutations in EBF3 Disturb Transcriptional Profiles and Cause Intellectual Disability, Ataxia, and Facial Dysmorphism (PMID: 28017373)
biological.summary: In HEK293T cells, EBF3 missense mutants were mislocalized to the cytoplasm, had reduced CDKN1A reporter transactivation, and were less tightly bound to chromatin. RNA-seq and ChIP-seq showed EBF3 acts as a transcriptional regulator and mutants had reduced genome-wide DNA binding and gene-regulatory activity.

biological.citation: Chao et al. 2017 - De Novo Mutations in EBF3 Cause a Neurodevelopmental Syndrome (PMID: 28017370)
biological.summary: De novo EBF3 loss-of-function and missense variants cause intellectual disability, ataxia and other features. Missense mutants had reduced transcriptional activity and a reduced ability to heterodimerize with wild-type EBF3.

biological.citation: Zhang et al. 2007 - An EBF3-mediated transcriptional program that induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis (PMID: 17018599)
biological.summary: EBF3 expression caused cell cycle arrest and apoptosis with caspase-3 activation. EBF3 binds the p21 promoter directly and regulates p21 and p27 promoter reporters. The locus is silenced by methylation in multiple tumor cell lines and reactivated by 5-aza-dC and TSA.

biological.citation: EBF3 reactivation by inhibiting the EGR1/EZH2/HDAC9 complex promotes metastasis via transcriptionally enhancing vimentin in nasopharyngeal carcinoma (PMID: 34906623)
biological.summary: EBF3 was elevated in metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma and binds the Vimentin promoter to upregulate it. EBF3 itself is epigenetically silenced by the EGR1/EZH2/HDAC9 complex through H3K27me3 at its promoter. High EBF3 correlated with poor survival.

biological.citation: Early B Cell Factor 3 (EBF3) attenuates Parkinson's disease through directly regulating CNTNAP4 transcription (PMID: 38479556)
biological.summary: EBF3 was downregulated in the substantia nigra of MPTP mice and in MPP+-treated SH-SY5Y cells, with low m6A modification (FTO-regulated). EBF3 overexpression reduced neuronal apoptosis and improved behavior. EBF3 binds the CNTNAP4 promoter and activates its transcription, and CNTNAP4 knockdown abolished the protective effect.

biological.citation: Ebf3-miR218 regulation is involved in the development of dopaminergic neurons (PMID: 25192643)
biological.summary: Ebf3 is upregulated in Dicer-knockout midbrain DA neurons and shows dynamic expression during DA neuron development. Overexpression in ES-cell differentiation increased TH+ DA neurons and suppression reduced them. Ebf3 is a target of miR218, which controls terminal DA neuron differentiation.
